q1_issues.issue: "for the hall" is encoded as Beneficiary although the hall is an inanimate venue naming where the projector is destined to be used, while the instruction set restricts Beneficiary to "only a party the event is done for the benefit of" and sends any other "for" to the preposition-named oblique.

notes: The passive is handled per the instruction set: the agentless "was sold" simply omits the Agent atom, the subject keeps the role the active object would have (Theme, an unchanged transferred object), and "to the school" is the transfer goal Recipient. Only the "for"-PP role is in question.
